items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, uh, I think we might ask about your sister that's living in New Iberia. Her name is, uh- George Bakke Dixon. [INTERVIEWEE] Dixon. [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. And is Mr. Dixon still living? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he's still living.
